methodology: We analyzed 80+ Reddit posts and 300+ comments across r/Bangkok, r/ThailandTourism, r/cocktails, and r/solotravel — spanning 2022 to 2026. Bars were cross-referenced with World's 50 Best Bars, Asia's 50 Best Bars, and Bangkok Bar Show Awards rankings. We weighted responses from Bangkok residents and regular visitors more heavily than tourist one-offs.
